input.content:
Compile the advertiser's prose into a PolicySpec. Return one or more clauses. Every clause must quote an exact, contiguous source_text span from the prose, with zero-based Python character offsets and an exclusive source_end. Do not invent policy requirements. Keep the advertiser, prose, and version exactly as provided. Use severity 0 or 1 for ALLOW intent, 2 for REVIEW, and 3 or 4 for BLOCK intent. Clause ids must be unique and stable-looking.

Advertiser: Demo Travel Co.
Version: 1
Advertiser prose:
Do not place our ads next to content that celebrates graphic violence or promotes illegal drug sales. Allow neutral news reporting and public-health discussion of those topics. Route suspected synthetic media impersonating public officials to review.

Clause.description:
One rule, compiled from a span of the advertiser's own prose.

`source_start` and `source_end` point back into the prose the advertiser wrote.
G0 checks that `prose[source_start:source_end] == source_text` exactly. A clause
that cannot point at the sentence it came from is a clause the model invented.
Clause.title: Clause

schema.description:
An advertiser's brand-safety policy, compiled from prose into checkable structure.

Hashed and versioned so that two runs of the same policy are provably the same
policy, and so that a revision produces a diff rather than an opaque replacement.
schema.title: PolicySpec

      "clause_id": "block-graphic-violence",
